_what: The Gemini arm of the frontier wording study: 220 matched pairs scored on a thresholded yes/no verdict, because the endpoint returns no next-token distribution to any caller.
_why: It measures what a binary outcome can resolve on a frontier model, which is the empirical form of the argument in §4.2 that binarising a graded outcome discards the comparison.
_naming_note: A rationale that uses the candidate's first name shows the model read it. That the verdict is constant anyway is the point: the threshold, not the model, is what has no resolution.
_limit: An arm that finds nothing cannot by itself separate 'no effect' from 'no resolution'. Two things license the second reading: the same design on models returning a distribution yields effects that are not zero, and the constancy here is exact rather than small -- a true null would scatter around zero, not repeat one value in every cell.
